about:
SCION 40 · trace measured from the replayed render (not copied from the score).
x_screen, y_screen: centroid of the dog's rendered layers (body card + head card alpha > .5), px.
facing: +1 when the rendered head card's muzzle point lies left of its skull point (toward the door), -1 right, 0 when the head is round the far side of the body (rear views) or the muzzle is hidden.
posture: rendered body-card height against its height in the first half second (standing > .88, crouched > .66, else lying).
state: segmented at onsets measured on these signals (see data/onsets.json).
x_score: the recovered body-card anchor X mapped back to score metres (the sill 0.56 m sits on the wall line).
dog_px_extent: the rendered dog's leftmost and rightmost pixel; the wall line (threshold) is x = 330 px.
